decisions.question: Should interpolated identifiers in GStrings ("hi ${name}") emit a Uses edge on the referenced variable/property? The gstring-interpolation fixture pins no-garbage-symbols only. Recommend: emit Uses (semantically a property read, matching field_access behavior).
decisions.resolution: DECLARED LIMITATION: tree-sitter-groovy produces NO string_interpolation/template nodes (probed 2026-08-27: "hi ${name}", triple-quoted and slashy forms all parse as opaque string literals). Interpolated identifiers cannot emit Uses without string parsing — out of scope; gstring-interpolation fixture pins no-garbage-symbols.

decisions.resolution: Suffix-resolve every bare parent to its FQN candidate(s) during the BFS; match on the declaring-owner bare name against symbolMap's Owner.method(sig) raw key. Probe-verified: BlackVal.val -> Node.val at conf 1.0; both groovy lanes 100%/0/0 at 200 files; fixture groovy/multihop-override-resolution pins the true target and forbids the fabricated one; mutant groovy/override-multihop-fallthrough.
